after.PASSED and VALIDATED: proposed to the owner as a paper strategy of its own (rule 14), sized by the risk engine for its tail, followed forward on paper; never real money
after.otherwise: reported as it is; nothing changes

spec.data: Yahoo daily closes (VIXY adjusted for its splits; the two indices as published), each file's sha256 in the manifest; a missing day is no trade

gates.costs_x2: mean daily net > 0 with the trading cost and the borrow fee doubled
gates.t: t of the mean daily net return over 2011-02..2021-12 >= the threshold
gates.timing: the rule beats an always-held short at its own average exposure: mean daily difference > 0, t >= 2.0
gates.top_year: no calendar year supplies more than 50% of the total net

spec.holdout_rule: 2022-01..2026-09: mean daily net > 0 with one-sided t >= 1.645, mean daily net > 0 with costs doubled, and the timing difference's mean > 0
spec.question: does shorting short-term VIX futures while the VIX term structure is in contango earn a positive net return, and beat always holding the short?
spec.rule: exposure for the day = -1 (short) when VIX / VIX3M at the previous close < 1, else 0; constant notional resized daily; costs on exposure changes and on each day's resizing; borrow on the short
